card: Split lab-ui.ts: Lab mode machine + shared replay transport under a thin canvas
guards: packages/game/src/bout-reader.test.ts (3 cases, unchanged, green before and after: step/play/scrub hashes equal replayBoutTo)
replay-golden.test.ts and VR parity vectors untouched (no simulator file changed beyond the pure tuning.ts helper)
deviations_from_card: 1) Three refactor(combat-lab) commits (core helper+test; transport+BoutReader; mode/forecast-view+lab-ui), following the card's rollback plan, each including its tests so every commit is green, rather than a separate red test(...) commit. 2) Case 7 as written fails on range, not coupling: the factory hitStunMaxS + 0.1 exceeds hitStunS's own field max (0.3), so validateTuning rejects it; the test starts from hitStunS 0.05 / hitStunMaxS 0.1 and raises to 0.2 (no tuning value changed). 3) No step-back hotkey was added to the Lab replay (the operator said hotkeys must not change); the transport supports step(-1) and Comma stays unhandled in the Lab (pinned by a test). So no reserved-code entry is needed for game-shell-ui B. 4) lab-ui.ts shrank 1166 -> 1112 lines, not the ~300 the card estimated: the setup, builds, tuning and spell-editor drawing stays in the canvas layer. 5) The u.screen checks in showForecast and frame stay, because they guard async and per-frame writes to canvas texts. refreshPanel now reads the mode.
notes: lab-mode.ts: LabModeState {mode, replayWasPaused} replaces the numeric/importing/replayPaused/replayWasPaused gates; labKey(state, code, repeat, host) -> action|notice|swallowed|unhandled; heading() derives the mode from the screen via labModeOf. HUD buttons go through the same press(code). replay-transport.ts: BoutReader keeps position/playing as accessors (arena-entry writes reader.playing). The Lab replay now clones a ring frame and re-filters events only when the position moves, not on every rendered frame. lab-forecast-view.ts: forecastLines(view, baseline='Current') and buildsForecastLine(view) return text+tone; forecastHeading(baseline) gives 'Census forecast vs Current'. For combat-lab B, pass the pinned name as baseline: the output is unchanged by default. First gate run: 3 vitest failures in answers.test/contact.test (arena-kernel sibling's in-flight work). Second run: vr drift.test raced sibling commits moving HEAD. Third run: exit 0, 704 vitest + all node tests green.
